comparisons.name: monogram-light
comparisons.description: The 98 pt monogram avatar of the Screen Time pane, Aqua. The initials are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: monogram-light-disc
comparisons.description: As monogram-light with the initials masked, to score the disc alone.

comparisons.name: monogram-dark
comparisons.description: The 98 pt monogram avatar of the Screen Time pane, Dark Aqua, whole crop: the capture draws the initials in the disc's own colour, the component in white, which is what differs (see monogram-dark-disc for the disc alone).

comparisons.name: monogram-dark-disc
comparisons.description: The monogram avatar of the Screen Time pane, Dark Aqua, with the initials masked: the capture draws them in the disc's own colour, the component in white.

comparisons.name: template-alignment-light
comparisons.description: 16 pt template images in 64 pt views, Aqua, placed with --mac-image-view-align and --mac-image-view-justify: the first in the top leading corner, the second in the bottom trailing corner. Then two 128 x 64 pt templates: one scaled down to 64 x 32 pt at the bottom of its view, one at its own size, larger than the view, aligned to its leading edge. Stand-in artwork; no screenshot can show this.
